protocol.scope: Supplied fixed pose batches and local pose refinement; NOT full-image detection or recall.
protocol.synthetic: Independent continuous harmonic/Gaussian field; RGB channels differ; no reuse of scorer resampling.
protocol.batch_candidates: 20% near truth, remaining random image positions/angles/scales; includes truth and outside-image cases.
protocol.local_seeds: Truth-perturbed seeds from declared error prior; test convergence basin only; no detector claims.
protocol.timing: Outer call wall includes Python/C ABI input conversion, NCC/refinement, submission/wait/output; excludes fixture/setup/verification.
protocol.memory: Fresh-process peak RSS includes Python, NumPy, fixture generation and setup. Metal allocations share RAM; do not add them to RSS. Reported retained buffers do not measure allocator transients.
protocol.correctness: All score vectors compared to CPU1, threshold 0.8, numerical tolerance 3e-5; best index is tie-aware. Independent float64 oracle checks selected poses.
protocol.accuracy: NCC>=0.8 plus precise <=0.5px/0.5deg/1%; existing gate <=2px/1deg/2%. Local success is separate from correctness.
protocol.precision: p95 is the empirical percentile of reported samples, not a confidence interval.
protocol.cuda: Not implemented or measured by this harness.
